blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The Department of Education (DepEd) is combining its nationwide laptop distribution with hands-on technology training for public school educators. On Friday, Education Secretary Sonny Angara led the official launch of GuroXL, a customized professional development program, during the laptop rollout at the Ynares Center in Antipolo City. According to a DepEd statement, 1,441 public school teachers in 62 schools in Antipolo received their new MacBook Neo laptops under the DepEd Computerization Program (DCP) and immediately began guided, practical learning sessions.
